cn_steps: 启用 `Procedural Vegetation Editor`（运行时 `ProceduralVegetation`，编辑器 `ProceduralVegetationEditor`）。
它是基于节点图的编辑器，可直接在引擎里做 Nanite Foliage 就绪植被。
加载含物种预构建数据的程序植被预设，再用节点图自定义/做变体。
属实验性植被工具；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Procedural Vegetation Editor` (runtime `ProceduralVegetation`, editor `ProceduralVegetationEditor`).
It is a node-graph editor for creating Nanite Foliage-ready vegetation in-engine.
Load Procedural Vegetation Presets with prebuilt species data, then customize/create variants in the graph.
It is an experimental vegetation tool; editor modules are Editor-target only.
note_cn: 节点图编辑器：在引擎里做 Nanite Foliage 植被。
note_en: Node-graph editor for Nanite Foliage-ready vegetation.

cn_steps: 启用 `Project Launcher`（模块 `ProjectLauncher`、`CommonLaunchExtensions`）。
它用来配置自定义项目启动配置文件（平台、cook、运行参数）。
在编辑器 Project Launcher 里建 profile，一键 cook/部署/运行到目标。
属编辑器开发者工具；默认不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `Project Launcher` (modules `ProjectLauncher`, `CommonLaunchExtensions`).
It configures custom project launch profiles (platform, cook, run args).
Build profiles in the editor Project Launcher to cook/deploy/run to a target in one step.
It is an editor/developer tool; it does not ship by default.
note_cn: 配置自定义项目启动/cook/部署 profile。

cn_steps: 启用 `Projects Module Tests`（模块 `ProjectsModuleTests`）。
它是 Projects 模块的 MTF 伴侣测试：插件发现、安装和瞬时注册。
跑这些测试来校验插件发现/挂载/瞬时注册行为。
属测试插件；一般只进测试/Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Projects Module Tests` (module `ProjectsModuleTests`).
It is the MTF companion testing the Projects module: plugin discovery, mounting, and transient registration.
Run these tests to validate plugin discovery/mounting/transient registration.
It is a test plugin; typically Editor/test targets only.
note_cn: Projects 模块的插件发现/挂载自动化测试。
note_en: MTF tests for Projects-module plugin discovery/mounting.

cn_steps: 启用 `Property Access Editor`（模块 `PropertyAccessEditor`）。
它提供把属性从一个对象复制到另一个对象的编辑器支持。
动画和 UMG 系统正常工作需要它（属性通路编辑）。
属编辑器支持插件；动画/UMG 项目应保持启用。
en_steps: Enable `Property Access Editor` (module `PropertyAccessEditor`).
It provides editor support for copying properties from one object to another.
Required for Animation and UMG systems to function correctly (property-access editing).
It is an editor-support plugin; keep it enabled for Animation/UMG projects.
note_cn: 属性复制/通路的编辑器支持（动画与 UMG 需要）。
note_en: Editor support for property copy/access (needed by Animation and UMG).

cn_steps: 启用 `Property Access Node`（模块 `PropertyAccessNode`）。
它提供通过属性路径访问属性的蓝图节点。
在蓝图里用该节点按路径读写对象属性，而不手写一长串 Get。
属编辑器蓝图节点插件；默认不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `Property Access Node` (module `PropertyAccessNode`).
It is a Blueprint node that accesses properties via a property path.
Use it in Blueprints to read/write object properties by path instead of a long Get chain.
It is an editor Blueprint-node plugin; it does not ship by default.
note_cn: 按属性路径访问属性的蓝图节点。
note_en: Blueprint node to access properties via a property path.

cn_steps: 启用 `Property Animator Core`（运行时 `PropertyAnimatorCore`，编辑器 `PropertyAnimatorCoreEditor`）。
它提供在运行时和编辑器中控制属性的可复用行为（核心层）。
作为 `Property Animator` 的底层依赖，不要单独当最终动画工具。
Game 模块依赖运行时模块；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Property Animator Core` (runtime `PropertyAnimatorCore`, editor `PropertyAnimatorCoreEditor`).
It provides reusable behaviors to control properties at runtime and in the editor (the core layer).
A low-level dependency for `Property Animator`; not the end-user animator by itself.
Game modules depend on runtime modules; editor modules are Editor-target only.
note_cn: 属性动画器的核心：可复用的属性控制行为。
note_en: Property Animator core: reusable property-control behaviors.

cn_steps: 启用 `Property Animator`（运行时 `PropertyAnimator`，编辑器 `PropertyAnimatorEditor`）。
它提供可复用行为，用来驱动一个或多个属性的值。
在 Actor 上加 Property Animator，给位置/颜色等属性做循环或程序化动画。
需 `Property Animator Core`；Game 模块依赖运行时模块。
en_steps: Enable `Property Animator` (runtime `PropertyAnimator`, editor `PropertyAnimatorEditor`).
It provides reusable behaviors to animate the value of one or more properties.
Add a Property Animator on an actor to loop or procedurally animate location/color/etc.
Requires `Property Animator Core`; game modules depend on runtime modules.
note_cn: 用可复用行为驱动一个或多个属性的动画。
note_en: Reusable behaviors to animate one or more property values.

cn_steps: 启用 `Property Editor Tests`（模块 `PropertyEditorTests`）。
它是 PropertyEditor 模块的自动化测试。
跑这些测试来校验细节面板/属性编辑器行为。
属测试插件；一般只进测试/Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Property Editor Tests` (module `PropertyEditorTests`).
It is automation tests for the PropertyEditor module.
Run these tests to validate Details panel / property-editor behavior.
It is a test plugin; typically Editor/test targets only.
note_cn: PropertyEditor 模块的自动化测试。
note_en: Automation tests for the PropertyEditor module.

cn_steps: 启用 `PropertyBindingUtils`（模块 `PropertyBindingUtils`、`PropertyBindingUtilsEditor`、`PropertyBindingUtilsTestSuite`）。
它提供实现属性绑定的实用代码。
写自定义绑定/动画通路时依赖这些工具，而不是从零实现路径解析。
运行时模块可进游戏包；编辑器/测试模块只进对应 Target。
en_steps: Enable `PropertyBindingUtils` (modules `PropertyBindingUtils`, `PropertyBindingUtilsEditor`, `PropertyBindingUtilsTestSuite`).
It provides utility code for implementing property bindings.
Depend on these utils when writing custom binding/anim access instead of parsing paths from scratch.
Runtime modules can ship in a cooked game; editor/test modules go to matching targets only.
note_cn: 实现属性绑定的实用代码。
note_en: Utility code for implementing property bindings.

cn_steps: 启用 `ProvenanceC2PA`（模块 `ProvenanceC2PA`）。
它用 C2PA 内容凭证标准实现 AssetProvenance 的读/写来源数据。
在需要资产出处/内容凭证的管线里启用，读写 C2PA 元数据。
属来源/凭证插件；按合规需求启用。
en_steps: Enable `ProvenanceC2PA` (module `ProvenanceC2PA`).
It implements AssetProvenance read/write using the C2PA content-credentials standard.
Enable it in pipelines that need asset provenance/content credentials to read/write C2PA metadata.
It is a provenance/credentials plugin; enable per compliance need.
note_cn: 用 C2PA 内容凭证读写资产来源数据。
note_en: Read/write asset provenance via C2PA content credentials.

cn_steps: 启用 `Proxy LOD Plugin (Experimental)`（模块 `ProxyLODMeshReduction`）。
它用于生成代理 LOD（把多网格合并简化成远景代理）。
在 HLOD/代理网格流程里用它生成远距离替代网格。
属实验性编辑器简化工具；默认不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `Proxy LOD Plugin (Experimental)` (module `ProxyLODMeshReduction`).
It generates Proxy LOD systems (merge/simplify meshes into a distant proxy).
Use it in HLOD/proxy-mesh flows to build far-distance stand-in meshes.
It is an experimental editor reduction tool; it does not ship by default.
note_cn: 生成代理 LOD（远景合并简化网格）。

cn_steps: 启用 `PSD Importer Material Designer Bridge`（模块 `PSDImporterMaterialDesignerBridge`）。
它在 PSD 导入器与 Material Designer 之间做桥接。
导入 PSD 图层后，把图层接到 Material Designer 材质图，而不是只当普通纹理。
属实验性导入桥；需 PSD Importer 与 Material Designer。
en_steps: Enable `PSD Importer Material Designer Bridge` (module `PSDImporterMaterialDesignerBridge`).
It bridges the PSD Importer and Material Designer.
After importing PSD layers, wire them into a Material Designer graph instead of plain textures only.
It is an experimental import bridge; requires PSD Importer and Material Designer.
note_cn: PSD 导入器与 Material Designer 的桥接。
note_en: Bridge between PSD Importer and Material Designer.

cn_steps: 启用 `PSD Importer`（模块 `PSDImporterEditor`、`PSDImporter`、`PSDImporterCore`）。
它把 Photoshop PSD 导入为引擎可用的图层/纹理资产。
把 `.psd` 拖进内容浏览器，按图层生成纹理或继续走 Material Designer 桥。
属实验性导入器；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `PSD Importer` (modules `PSDImporterEditor`, `PSDImporter`, `PSDImporterCore`).
It imports Photoshop PSD files as engine-ready layer/texture assets.
Drop a `.psd` into the Content Browser to generate per-layer textures, or continue through the Material Designer bridge.
It is an experimental importer; editor modules are Editor-target only.
note_cn: 把 Photoshop PSD 导入为图层/纹理资产。
note_en: Import Photoshop PSDs as layer/texture assets.

cn_steps: 启用 `Python Automation Test`（模块 `PythonAutomationTest`）。
它提供 Python 自动化测试支持（在编辑器自动化框架里跑 Python 用例）。
编写 Python 测试并纳入自动化会话，校验编辑器脚本行为。
属测试插件；需 Python 脚本插件。
en_steps: Enable `Python Automation Test` (module `PythonAutomationTest`).
It supports Python automation tests (run Python cases in the editor automation framework).
Write Python tests and include them in automation sessions to validate editor scripting.
It is a test plugin; requires the Python script plugin.
note_cn: 在编辑器自动化框架里跑 Python 测试。
note_en: Run Python tests in the editor automation framework.

cn_steps: 启用 `Python Editor Script Plugin`（模块 `PythonScriptPluginPreload`、`PythonScriptPlugin`）。
它为虚幻编辑器提供 Python 集成（解释器、脚本执行、编辑器 API）。
在输出窗口/脚本编辑器里跑 Python，或用 `unreal` 模块做批处理。
属实验性编辑器脚本插件；默认不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `Python Editor Script Plugin` (modules `PythonScriptPluginPreload`, `PythonScriptPlugin`).
It provides Python integration for the Unreal Editor (interpreter, script execution, editor API).
Run Python in the Output Log/script editor, or batch through the `unreal` module.
It is an experimental editor-scripting plugin; it does not ship by default.
note_cn: 虚幻编辑器的 Python 集成。
note_en: Python integration for the Unreal Editor.
